method: Wash and dry the rocket and tomato; shred the leaves and slice the tomato thinly. Reserve most of the leaves and any excess tomato for a side salad so the wholemeal bagel can close.
Use ready-cooked canned chickpeas. Drain and rinse before weighing, then roughly mash with a fork so the filling holds together.
Finely grate the measured reduced-fat cheddar. Use all the measured olive oil to dress the prepared vegetables.
Split the wholemeal bagel. Toast the cut halves lightly if desired, then let them cool slightly before filling.

Combine the prepared filling with the grated reduced-fat cheddar. Add a small handful of the prepared leaves and some sliced tomato. Put a manageable layer of filling on the lower bagel half and add the top. Serve all remaining filling and vegetables alongside as the side salad.
Eat now, or put the meal and any side salad into a covered container and refrigerate promptly. Eat within 24 hours and follow any shorter ingredient use-by date; keep it chilled until eating.
